name: session-memory
description: Mines every session for decisions, rules, root causes and gotchas, and files them in a topic tree per repo group, each item with the session quotes it came from

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that extracts and files memory items

dailyCalls.title: Model calls per day
dailyCalls.description: Cap on extract and split calls per day; past it, work waits for the next day

sweepMax.title: Transcripts per sweep
sweepMax.description: How many unfinished transcripts a new session picks up in the background

autoGroups.title: Auto groups
autoGroups.description: File a git repo no rule covers into a group with one model call

judge.title: Nudge judge
judge.description: Model that decides whether a matched memory item fits the conversation: jev (OpenRouter /v1/systemone) or clef (Cloudflare Workers AI, through a gateway that takes {model, input} at /v1/run)

judgeUrl.title: Judge URL
judgeUrl.description: Endpoint for the judge. Empty: OpenRouter for jev; clef needs your gateway's /v1/run URL

judgeKey.title: Judge key
judgeKey.description: Bearer key for the judge URL. Empty turns nudges off

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Empty: jev-1.13 for jev, clef for clef

nudgeMin.title: Nudge threshold
nudgeMin.description: Judge YES probability at or above which the agent is told to call memory_search. Empty: 0.8 for jev, 0.7 for clef
